about_the_game:
Welcome to the very early prototype of Climbing Chaos: Much Earlier Access, where sharks with arms and legs defy physics (and basic motor skills) in a hilarious, experimental party game about climbing and exploring solo or with friends!

Move your body and each arm independently to grab, climb, and explore a world designed for ragdoll physics moments, leaps of faith, teamwork, and hilarity. What should be as easy as reaching out and grabbing something is…well, much harder than it looks. You'll laugh, you'll scream, and you'll probably fall a lot.

There are a variety of game modes and a playground full of toys to test out your acrobatic moves. There’s even a gladiator arena, where you can fight to be the last shark standing.

Up to four players can scramble together in local co-op, or play remotely with Steam Remote Play Together! Don't have friends to play with? We've implemented a way for a solo player to control multiple sharks and still enjoy the multiplayer experience by themselves.

This is still incredibly early (and it took some convincing of the studio heads to let us start talking about it already). The graphics are placeholder, but we think we’re onto something with the gameplay. There are still tons of bugs, but it’s already fun, so why not share the madness?

It’s ridiculous and charmingly janky, but it's somehow still a blast. Follow us on Steam or join our Discord to get the latest updates and join us on this chaotic journey!

short_description: Grab, climb, and tumble through this early prototype of a ridiculous physics-based party game! Move your body and each arm independently, climb anything you can grab, and embrace the chaos with up to four players. Is it too early to show this? Absolutely, but what's the worst that could happen?
